description: Versioned finding-rule catalog for the Invoice Integrity agent. Detects fraud/compliance-shaped anomalies on uploaded, unpaid obligations before they're paid. Adding or modifying a rule requires re-signing the agent's policy template.

rules.description: Another open obligation shares the same counterparty, amount, currency, and due date.
Multiple obligations to the same counterparty on the same due date, each below a configured threshold but summing above it.
An obligation amount sits just below a configured approval threshold.
A high-value obligation is owed to a counterparty with no matching verified counterparty record.
